title: Which kind of trouble are you?
intro: Six quick questions. Tap the answer that sounds most like you, and we'll point you to the Ashley Claudy book to start with.

questions.q: It's Friday night. Where are you?

options.text: At an underground race, engines in my chest
In the stands while the home team scores
In the gym after hours, wrapping my hands
At a party where nobody is who they say they are

questions.q: Pick the red flag you'd ignore.

options.text: He races for money
Everyone on campus has an opinion about him
He fights for a living
His family has more secrets than money
Fierce loyalty, even when it costs me
Showing up at every single game
Protecting you, even from yourself
A secret only we know
A small town where everyone knows the club
A college campus in the fall
A boxing gym that smells like old leather
A big house where nobody says what they mean
I thrive on it
I rise above it
I fight back, literally if I have to
I keep notes. I remember everything
Second chances with the one who got away

A one-night stand that won't stay one night
